hero_sub: KRISHAK helps Indian farmers compare market opportunities across APMCs and verified corporate buyers, forecast seasonal price trajectories, and calculate multi-channel selling splits for the highest take-home payout.
philosophy: Do not simply show farmers the highest market price. Analyze all available selling opportunities and recommend the strategy that maximizes the farmer's expected profit.
split_allocation_title: Split Allocation: 60% Verified Industrial Buyer + 40% APMC Benchmark
profit_delta_desc: better than selling all produce in the highest-price market (due to freight and mandi cess deductions).
profit_delta_better: Better than selling all produce into a single high-distance market.
prices_verified_note: Prices verified with live APMC feeds and buyer escrow commitments.
how_dhanya_found: How KRISHAK Found Your Best Deal
simple_explanation: KRISHAK compares all available selling opportunities and finds the combination expected to give you the highest overall profit.
farmer_login_sub: Enter your registered mobile number to access your profit optimization dashboard.
buyer_login_sub: Direct farm-gate sourcing for food processors, traders, and exporters.
admin_login_sub: Authorized access for platform governance, escrow clearance, and market price overrides.
list_produce_sub: Add your harvest to find direct verified buyers and calculate maximum net profit.
post_req_sub: Broadcast your purchase tender to verified farmers in high-yield clusters.
